facts.evidence: NVIDIA reports Q2 FY27 revenue of $96.2 billion, up 106% year-over-year... Revenue for the second quarter ended July 26, 2026, was $96.2 billion, an increase of 18% from the previous quarter and 106% from the same period last year.
GAAP diluted earnings per share were $2.46, compared to non-GAAP diluted earnings per share of $2.22.
Data Center revenue reached $89.0 billion, representing a 117% increase from the prior year and an 18% increase from the previous quarter.
Both GAAP and non-GAAP gross margins stood at 75.0% for the quarter. (The +2.6 pt year-over-year GAAP change is not given, but nothing stated is wrong.)
For the third quarter of fiscal 2027, revenue is expected to be $108.0 billion, plus or minus 2%. The company states it is not assuming any Data Center compute revenue from China in this outlook.
The release highlights the ramp of the Vera Rubin platform into full production, with racks running at partners including CoreWeave, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

NVIDIA returned approximately $26.0 billion to shareholders in the second quarter through share repurchases and cash dividends. / As of the end of the second quarter, the company had approximately $99.0 billion remaining under its share repurchase authorization.
Edge Computing revenue was $7.2 billion, up 27% year-over-year and 13% quarter-over-quarter.

claims.claim: NVIDIA reported Q2 FY27 revenue of $96.2 billion.
Revenue was up 106% year-over-year.
Data Center drove the majority of the revenue growth.
claims.note: The release does not disclose prior-year Data Center revenue, so Data Center's share of the total revenue increase cannot be determined without deriving the year-ago base from the 117% growth rate and comparing it to total growth — a calculation the release does not show.

claims.claim: The second quarter ended July 26, 2026.
Revenue increased 18% from the previous quarter.
GAAP net income was $59.7 billion for the quarter.
Non-GAAP net income was $54.0 billion for the quarter.
GAAP diluted earnings per share were $2.46.
Non-GAAP diluted earnings per share were $2.22.
Both GAAP and non-GAAP gross margins were 75.0% for the quarter.
GAAP operating expenses were $8.4 billion.
Non-GAAP operating expenses were $8.2 billion.
Data Center revenue was $89.0 billion.
Data Center revenue increased 117% from the prior year.
Data Center revenue increased 18% from the previous quarter.
Edge Computing revenue was $7.2 billion.
Edge Computing revenue was up 27% year-over-year.
Edge Computing revenue was up 13% quarter-over-quarter.
The Vera Rubin platform is ramping into full production, with racks running at partners including CoreWeave, Google Cloud and Microsoft Azure.
NVIDIA announced strategic partnerships with Apollo, BlackRock, Blackstone, Brookfield, Goldman Sachs and KKR to mobilize over $500 billion of third-party capital for AI infrastructure buildout.
For Q3 fiscal 2027, revenue is expected to be $108.0 billion, plus or minus 2%.
The company is not assuming any Data Center compute revenue from China in its outlook.
GAAP and non-GAAP gross margins are expected to be 74.0%, plus or minus 50 basis points.
GAAP operating expenses are expected to be approximately $9.2 billion.
Non-GAAP operating expenses are expected to be approximately $9.0 billion.
NVIDIA returned approximately $26.0 billion to shareholders in the second quarter through share repurchases and cash dividends.
As of the end of the second quarter, approximately $99.0 billion remained under the share repurchase authorization.
The next quarterly cash dividend of $0.25 per share is scheduled to be paid on October 1, 2026.
Beginning in the first quarter of fiscal 2027, NVIDIA's non-GAAP financial measures no longer exclude stock-based compensation expense, which alters the basis for adjusted figures.
The $108.0 billion outlook excludes Data Center compute revenue from China.
The company expects GAAP and non-GAAP tax rates for full-year fiscal 2027 to be between 16.0% and 18.0%, excluding discrete items and material changes to the tax environment.
